data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Hanaa means 'gift' or 'grace'. It is derived from the root h-n-y, which conveys the idea of giving and generosity. In Islamic tradition, Hanaa symbolizes the blessings bestowed upon us by Allah, reminding us to be grateful and generous in return. The name Hanaa carries the meaning “Gift, Grace” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hanaa usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
